label: DOC biodiversity platform development
summary: National and conservancy work begins the lineage that develops into DOCgis and the National Enterprise GIS. The annual report records the Biodiversity Information Platform work during 2000/01 and a planned August 2001 pilot. A staff recollection supplied for this edition credits Eagle Technology with designing DOCgis before the 2003 releases.
